name: Binary Disassembly & Analysis
description: Disassembly and analysis of compiled binaries across architectures (x86, x64, ARM). Covers use of disassemblers (IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja), reading assembly code, control flow analysis, data structure recovery, and cross-referencing to understand program behavior.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands binary analysis concepts and tools
evidence: Can explain the difference between source code, assembly, and machine code
Familiar with major disassemblers (IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja)
Understands basic x86/x64 instruction set and calling conventions

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reads disassembly and performs basic analysis under supervision
evidence: Loaded binaries into Ghidra or IDA Pro and navigated the disassembly
Identified function boundaries, strings, and cross-references
Traced basic control flow and identified conditional logic
Work reviewed by authorized analyst

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently analyzes binaries to understand functionality and identify vulnerabilities
evidence: Independently analyzed binaries on 5+ engagements or research projects
Reads x86/x64 and ARM assembly fluently for common patterns
Identifies vulnerability patterns (buffer overflows, format strings, integer issues) in disassembly
Uses scripting (IDAPython, Ghidra scripts) for analysis automation
Passed proficiency assessment on binary disassembly

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Analyzes complex and obfuscated binaries; recovers data structures
evidence: Analyzes stripped and statically linked binaries
Recovers C++ class hierarchies and virtual function tables from binaries
Develops analysis scripts and plugins for recurring patterns
Mentors junior analysts on disassembly methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on binary analysis; develops tooling; handles any architecture
evidence: Published research on binary analysis techniques or tools
Developed the lab's binary analysis methodology and tooling
Analyzes binaries across multiple architectures (x86, ARM, MIPS, RISC-V)
Trains teams on binary disassembly and analysis

assessment_methods.description: Analyze a stripped binary to identify its purpose, key algorithms, and any security vulnerabilities
Observe use of disassembler for navigation, annotation, and analysis of an unfamiliar binary
